title: Analysis: China’s clean-tech exports in 2026 to avoid as much CO2 as Brazil emits in a year - Carbon Brief
gist: CREA's Lauri Myllyvirta estimates China's 2026 clean-tech exports will avoid ~450MtCO2 annually (≈ Brazil's emissions, ~2% of non-China emissions) and 8,400MtCO2 over equipment lifetimes, led by solar and concentrated (76%) in the global south. He argues the exports have largely been additional rather than displacing rival producers, but a domestic Chinese solar slump could push exports above home deployment and inflame trade tensions.
